# Lab 05 hints

<details><summary>Hint 1 — Preserve tuple boundaries</summary>

A delimiter can appear inside an input. Encode a structured sequence rather than joining unescaped text.

</details>

<details><summary>Hint 2 — Stable encoding, stable digest</summary>

JSON encodes a list of three strings without confusing the boundaries. Fix formatting and text encoding before hashing.

</details>

<details><summary>Hint 3 — Standard-library hash</summary>

`hashlib.sha256(canonical_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()` produces a stable bounded string. Python's built-in `hash()` is unsuitable for a durable cross-process identity because its result can vary between processes.

</details>
